{{Top|leg}}
'''Breather hoods''' were part of the standard uniform for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[cold assault stormtrooper]]s. Fitting over the snowtrooper's faceplate, the breather hood helped them to breathe in extremely cold and dangerous environments.
